_about: Premade art objects and books, generated exactly as they were made (no material, gem or quality variations). Contributed by Leo. Each entry: name, creator, make (Molded/Carved/Clothing/Book), level (the SRD art value row it is rolled with), formula (its value in gp), avg, weight, img, desc (HTML), tags, source, subType.

items.name: Bronze Statuette of a Hunting Hound
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A palm-sized bronze hound frozen mid-stride, every rib and tendon carefully modeled. The base bears the maker's tiny crescent stamp.

items.name: Marble Bust of a Stern Magistrate
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A finely carved white marble bust of a severe middle-aged magistrate in layered robes. The sculptor captured a deep crease between the brows and an unmistakable air of judgment.

items.name: Painted Panel of the Harvest Dance
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A bright wooden panel depicting villagers dancing beneath sheaves of wheat and autumn garlands. The pigments remain vivid despite light cracking along the edges.

items.name: Bronze Horse and Rider Figurine
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A compact bronze cavalry figure showing a rider turning sharply in the saddle. The horse's mane is deeply incised and polished by years of handling.

items.name: Carved Oak Relief of the Green Man
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A heavy oak plaque depicting a bearded face emerging from leaves and vines. The carving is deep, expressive, and darkened by age.

items.name: Silvered Icon of the Dawn Saint
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A devotional panel with a silvered halo and painted robes, showing the saint raising one hand in blessing over a sunrise.

items.name: Terracotta Figurine of a Laughing Child
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small fired-clay figurine of a child clutching a hoop. Its charm comes from lively expression rather than expensive material.

items.name: Painted Battle Standard Panel
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A framed painted scene of infantry forming a shield wall beneath a red-and-black banner. Smoke curls across the distant hills.

items.name: Alabaster Dove Sculpture
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A smooth alabaster dove with folded wings and delicately drilled eyes. The stone is translucent at the feather tips.

items.name: Bronze Bust of a Guild Founder
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A compact bronze portrait bust showing an elderly artisan with measuring tools tucked into his belt. The base records his guild title in neat lettering.

items.name: Painted Triptych of the Three Virtues
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: Three hinged panels depict Charity, Courage, and Wisdom as richly dressed figures. Fine gold paint highlights halos, jewelry, and decorative borders.

items.name: Carved Walnut Hunting Scene
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A rectangular walnut relief showing riders, hounds, and a stag threading through dense woodland. Tiny antlers and leaves are carved with remarkable precision.

items.name: Bronze Cat Figurine
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A sleek bronze cat seated upright with tail curled neatly around its paws. The ears and whisker lines are sharply defined.

items.name: Marble Hand of Victory
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A life-sized marble hand gripping a laurel branch, apparently broken from a larger statue and later mounted on a small black base.

items.name: Painted Portrait of a Merchant Matron
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A dignified oil portrait of a prosperous merchant woman seated beside a ledger and imported porcelain cup. Fine brushwork emphasizes fabric and jewelry.

items.name: Ivory-Toned Bone Relief of Sea Serpents
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A polished bone plaque carved with intertwining sea serpents and ships. Despite the dramatic subject, it is entirely mundane craftsmanship.

items.name: Bronze Ram's Head Wall Ornament
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A hollow-cast bronze ram's head with curling horns intended for mounting above a doorway or hearth.

items.name: Painted Miniature of Twin Princes
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A paired portrait miniature showing two young princes in matching blue coats. The likenesses are remarkably lifelike for such a small work.

items.name: Marble Garden Nymph
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A knee-high marble figure of a smiling nymph holding a wreath of carved ivy. Weathering suggests it once stood outdoors.

items.name: Gilded Wooden Angel Figure
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A carved wooden angel with folded wings, painted robes, and thin gold leaf over the halo and feather tips.

items.name: Bronze Falcon on Perch
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A detailed bronze falcon perched with one wing half-open. The talons grip a tiny branch cast as part of the base.

items.name: Painted Seascape of the Storm Coast
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A dramatic coastal painting showing black cliffs, white surf, and a merchant vessel struggling under torn canvas.

items.name: Marble Lion Cub
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small marble sculpture of a lion cub pawing at a carved ball. The face is playful rather than regal.

items.name: Carved Elm Mask of Winter
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A ceremonial wall mask with elongated cheeks, closed eyes, and a crown of carved bare branches.

items.name: Bronze Dancing Girl
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A graceful bronze figure captured mid-turn, one arm raised and garments flowing around the legs.

items.name: Painted Icon of Saint Orrel
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small religious panel depicting Saint Orrel holding a lantern before a dark cave. The halo is picked out in gold paint.

items.name: Marble Scholar at His Desk
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A compact marble sculpture of a seated scholar hunched over an open book, with tiny scrolls stacked beside him.

items.name: Bronze Boar Figurine
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A sturdy little bronze boar with bristled back and lowered tusks, likely commissioned as a hunting trophy or family emblem.

items.name: Painted Noble Family Portrait
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A large formal portrait depicting six members of a noble household posed beneath ancestral banners.

items.name: Carved Cedar Shrine Panel
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A fragrant cedar panel carved with nested arches, stars, and stylized flames. Traces of old blue paint remain in recesses.

items.name: Marble Griffin Statuette
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A finely carved marble griffin seated alertly, with individually cut feathers and a sharply defined beak.

items.name: Bronze Fishmonger Figure
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A humorous bronze sculpture of a fishmonger holding up an oversized carp while a cat reaches toward his basket.

items.name: Painted Landscape of the Silver Vale
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A serene landscape of rolling fields, a distant manor, and a pale river winding through morning mist.

items.name: Carved Boxwood Saint Figurine
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A slender boxwood saint carved with prayer beads, layered robes, and a tiny book at the waist.

items.name: Marble Sleeping Hound
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A low marble sculpture of a curled sleeping hound, with folded ears and a paw tucked beneath its muzzle.

items.name: Bronze Twin Serpents
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A decorative bronze piece showing two serpents coiled around one another in a balanced spiral.

items.name: Painted Tavern Signboard
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A richly painted signboard showing a golden stag beneath a crescent moon. The edges are reinforced for hanging outdoors.

items.name: Carved Pine Nativity Scene
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small multi-figure devotional carving arranged beneath an arched wooden shelter. The figures are simple but expressive.

items.name: Marble Bust of an Unknown Poet
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An elegant marble bust of a youthful poet with loose hair and a thoughtful downward gaze. The inscription on the base has been worn away.

items.name: Bronze Owl Statuette
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A squat bronze owl with wide incised eyes and neatly layered feathers, often used as a scholar's desk ornament.

items.name: Painted Scene of a Royal Procession
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A long horizontal painting filled with banners, mounted guards, musicians, courtiers, and cheering townsfolk.

items.name: Carved Ashwood Relief of River Spirits
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A flowing relief of three river spirits emerging from waves and reeds, with fish and lilies worked into the border.

items.name: Marble Cherub with Garland
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small marble cherub carrying a garland of carved flowers over one shoulder.

items.name: Bronze Miner with Pick
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A sturdy bronze figure of a miner leaning on a pickaxe, boots planted wide and lamp hanging from his belt.

items.name: Painted Portrait of a Court Musician
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A half-length portrait of a musician holding a lute, dressed in deep green velvet with silver braid.

items.name: Carved Bone Plaque of the Zodiac
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A circular bone plaque divided into twelve zodiac signs, each rendered as a tiny engraved figure.

items.name: Marble Wolf Head
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A marble wall sculpture of a snarling wolf's head with deeply drilled fur and bared teeth.

items.name: Bronze Mother and Child
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A tender bronze statuette of a mother lifting a laughing child onto one hip.

items.name: Painted Mountain Monastery
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A vertical landscape depicting a monastery clinging to snowy cliffs above a winding pilgrim road.

items.name: Carved Oak Dragon Panel
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A heavy oak panel showing a dragon coiled around a tower, with smoke and clouds cut into deep relief.

items.name: Marble Laurel Wreath Plaque
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A circular marble plaque carved with overlapping laurel leaves and a blank central cartouche.

items.name: Bronze Stag Figurine
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A slender bronze stag with branching antlers and one foreleg raised as though listening.

items.name: Painted Harvest Madonna
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A rural devotional painting of a maternal saint figure surrounded by wheat, apples, and kneeling villagers.

items.name: Carved Cherrywood Dancer
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A polished cherrywood figure of a dancer balancing on one foot, skirt carved into sweeping folds.

items.name: Marble Pair of Doves
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: Two small marble doves touching beaks atop a shared base, often given as a wedding gift.

items.name: Bronze Ship Model
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A detailed bronze model of a three-masted merchant ship, complete with rails, rigging lines, and tiny deck fittings.

items.name: Painted City Gate at Dusk
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A warm-toned urban painting showing carts and pedestrians passing beneath a fortified city gate as lamps are lit.

items.name: Carved Limestone Pilgrim
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A weathered limestone figure of a cloaked pilgrim holding a staff and shell token.

items.name: Bronze Scholar's Hand
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A bronze study of a human hand holding a quill above a small tablet, likely intended as a desk ornament.

items.name: Painted Portrait of a Naval Captain
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A formal portrait of a broad-shouldered captain standing beside a chart table with a storm visible beyond the window.

items.name: Carved Birchwood Swan
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A smooth birchwood swan with extended neck and subtle feather carving along the wings.

items.name: Marble Child with Flute
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small marble figure of a child seated cross-legged while playing a simple flute.

items.name: Bronze Rooster Figure
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A proud bronze rooster with tail feathers fanned upward, commonly used as a household or guild ornament.

items.name: Painted Orchard in Spring
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A delicate painting of flowering orchard rows beneath pale clouds, with workers carrying ladders in the distance.

items.name: Carved Oak Ancestral Plaque
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A heraldic plaque bearing a deeply carved family crest, motto ribbon, and decorative oak leaves.

items.name: Marble Falcon
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A poised marble falcon with folded wings and head turned sharply to one side.

items.name: Bronze Shepherd and Lamb
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small pastoral bronze showing a shepherd kneeling to lift a lamb from brambles.

items.name: Painted Scene of the First Snow
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A quiet winter scene of rooftops, smoke, and children running through the first snowfall of the season.

items.name: Carved Walnut Bust of a Sailor
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A dark walnut bust of an older sailor with braided beard and heavy coat, polished smooth at the nose and shoulders.

items.name: Marble Serpent Coil
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An abstract marble sculpture of a serpent curled into a tight spiral, scales picked out with shallow chisel marks.

items.name: Bronze Harvest Maiden
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A bronze maiden carrying a sheaf of wheat over one shoulder, with a sickle hanging at her side.

items.name: Painted Portrait of a Young Heir
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A carefully executed portrait of a noble child standing beside a carved chair and holding a small hunting falcon glove.

items.name: Carved Lindenwood Angel Choir
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A wall relief of five singing angels, each with distinct expressions and tiny open songbooks.

items.name: Marble Turtle Fountain Figure
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A decorative marble turtle intended to sit in a fountain basin, its open mouth drilled to carry a water pipe.

items.name: Bronze Bear Cub
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A charming bronze bear cub standing on hind legs with paws raised.

items.name: Painted River Market
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A lively market painting filled with barges, fish stalls, porters, awnings, and riverside warehouses.

items.name: Carved Oak Saint's Head
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A devotional carving of a serene saint's head with traces of red and blue paint in the hair and collar.

items.name: Marble Dog with Game Bird
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A hunting-themed marble sculpture of a hound standing over a retrieved bird.

items.name: Bronze Fox Figurine
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small bronze fox crouched low with its tail wrapped around its feet, eyes picked out in polished brass.

items.name: Painted Vineyard at Sunset
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A richly colored landscape of vineyard rows glowing beneath a low red sun, with workers carrying baskets toward a press house.

items.name: Carved Cedar Moon Goddess
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A graceful cedar figurine of a moon goddess with a crescent headdress and folded hands.

items.name: Marble Ram
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A compact marble ram with curled horns, often displayed as a symbol of stubborn courage and prosperity.

items.name: Bronze Two-Horse Chariot
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A detailed bronze chariot group with two rearing horses and a cloaked driver leaning forward.

items.name: Painted Scholar's Study
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An intimate interior scene showing a scholar at night surrounded by books, candles, instruments, and rolled maps.

items.name: Carved Oak Mermaid Figure
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A decorative oak mermaid carved for a ship's cabin or tavern wall, with flowing hair and a curling fish tail.

items.name: Marble Vine Maiden
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A classical marble maiden with grapes and vine leaves draped across one arm.

items.name: Bronze Hound Pair
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A matched pair of bronze hunting hounds mounted together on one rectangular base.

items.name: Painted Coronation Scene
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A formal historical painting showing a kneeling monarch receiving a crown before clergy, nobles, and banners.

items.name: Carved Beechwood Falconer
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A standing wooden figure of a falconer with hooded bird perched on one gloved hand.

items.name: Marble Swan Fountain Head
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A carved marble swan neck and head designed to spout water from its beak.

items.name: Bronze Temple Dancer
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A slim bronze dancer with bracelets, layered skirt, and one foot raised in a formal pose.

items.name: Painted Winter Hunt
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A broad landscape showing mounted hunters and hounds crossing snow beneath bare trees.

items.name: Carved Walnut Scholar Relief
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A rectangular walnut panel depicting a scholar teaching three students beneath an arched colonnade.

items.name: Marble Eagle with Spread Wings
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A dramatic marble eagle standing with wings half-spread and talons gripping a rocky base.

items.name: Bronze Dolphin Pair
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: Two stylized bronze dolphins leap in opposite directions from a shared wave-shaped base.

items.name: Painted Harbor at Morning
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A bright harbor scene of fishing boats, gulls, dockworkers, and pale sunlight reflecting off calm water.

items.name: Carved Elmwood Knight
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A painted wooden knight in ceremonial armor, standing with both hands resting on the pommel of a sword.

items.name: Marble Mourning Woman
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small funerary sculpture of a veiled woman seated with head bowed and hands folded in her lap.

items.name: Bronze Griffin Bookend Pair
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A matched pair of bronze griffins designed as heavy bookends, each crouched with wings raised.

items.name: Painted Feast of Lanterns
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A festive night scene crowded with lanterns, musicians, food stalls, and families gathered around a town square.

items.name: The Ashen Crown Chronicle
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A soot-darkened calfskin chronicle recounting the rise and ruin of the Ashen Crown dynasty. Marginal notes in three hands argue over which king first betrayed the old northern compact.

items.name: Bestiary of the Reed Marsh
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A waxed-leather field bestiary filled with precise sketches of marsh beasts, spoor, feeding habits, and folk remedies for their bites. Several pages bear brown water stains and pressed reeds.

items.name: The Brass Navigator
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A compact sailor's manual bound with brass corners, describing currents, stars, coastal hazards, and the traditional signals of merchant fleets. Its foldout charts are hand-colored and carefully annotated.

items.name: Songs Beneath the Barrow
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A collection of old burial songs copied onto thick vellum. The verses describe forgotten chiefs, oath rings, winter feasts, and the proper gifts owed to honored dead.

items.name: The Orchard Keeper's Year
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A practical seasonal guide to pruning, grafting, preserving fruit, and judging soil. Fine woodcuts show dozens of orchard pests and the damage each leaves behind.

items.name: Letters from the Sapphire Road
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A bound collection of correspondence written by a caravan factor traveling the eastern trade route. The letters mix business accounts with vivid descriptions of inns, toll houses, and desert cities.

items.name: The Quiet Art of Locks
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A discreet artisan's treatise on wards, keys, tumblers, hidden catches, and locksmithing etiquette. Diagrams are exact enough to interest both honest craftsmen and less reputable readers.

items.name: Lives of the Twelve Abbots
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An illuminated religious history presenting twelve abbots as models of patience, charity, learning, and stern discipline. Each chapter opens with a painted portrait framed in gold leaf.

items.name: On the Breeding of Warhorses
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A noble stablemaster's manual covering bloodlines, temperament, feeding, training, hoof care, and the selection of mounts for cavalry. Pedigree tables fill the final third of the book.

items.name: The Copper Kitchen
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A richly illustrated cookbook devoted to sauces, pies, roasts, preserved meats, and banquet presentation. Grease marks suggest it was prized in an actual noble kitchen rather than kept merely for display.

items.name: Annals of Blackwater Keep
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A fortress ledger turned local history, recording sieges, repairs, births, deaths, taxes, and notable visitors over nearly two centuries. Several entries hint at tunnels omitted from later maps.

items.name: The Falconer's Companion
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A practical volume on raptor training, mews construction, quarry selection, and treatment of common injuries. Delicate feather studies are painted beside the text.

items.name: The Seven Courtesies
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A slim etiquette book outlining greetings, introductions, gift-giving, precedence, mourning customs, and conduct at table. The prose is polished, severe, and widely quoted among lesser nobles.

items.name: The Red Ledger of Kars
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A merchant house account book preserving decades of prices, debts, routes, and favored clients. Although old, it offers valuable insight into historic trade patterns and family rivalries.

items.name: An Herbal of Winter Remedies
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A healer's compendium focused on coughs, frostbite, fever, chilblains, and hunger sickness. Each remedy includes substitutions for remote villages with poor access to imported ingredients.

items.name: Tales of the Moonlit Ford
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A beautifully penned collection of ghost stories set around a famous river crossing. The tales are unsettling without being crude, and the closing story ends with a page intentionally left blank.

items.name: The Mason's Measure
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A technical handbook on foundations, arches, walls, lime, drainage, and quarry stone. Foldout diagrams show the proportions used in bridges, towers, and vaulted halls.

items.name: The Book of Little Oaths
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A legal clerk's reference compiling minor contracts, household vows, apprenticeship terms, and common formulas of sworn service. Blank spaces allow names and dates to be entered.

items.name: The Pearl Coast Gazetteer
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A coastal geography describing ports, reefs, customs duties, local rulers, fisheries, and seasonal winds. Tiny painted ships mark safe anchorages along the margins.

items.name: Reflections on Just Rule
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A philosophical dialogue between a queen and her imprisoned tutor concerning law, mercy, taxation, rebellion, and the obligations of rulers to the poor.

items.name: The Miller's Reckoning
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A trade manual explaining grain grades, millstones, waterwheels, toll customs, flour fraud, and basic bookkeeping. Tables make it especially useful to rural stewards.

items.name: The Hidden Saints of Valmere
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A devotional book describing obscure local saints, roadside shrines, relic customs, and miracle tales. Pilgrim notes crowd many margins in different inks.

items.name: The Duke's Book of Hounds
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A lavish kennel record and hunting manual featuring painted portraits of famous hounds. Notes cover breeding, scent training, pack hierarchy, and treatment after a hard chase.

items.name: The Glassmaker's Flame
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An artisan text on furnace construction, sand selection, pigments, annealing, blowing, cutting, and gilding glass. Some formulas are written in a private workshop cipher.

items.name: Ballads of the Iron Hills
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A sturdy songbook of mining chants, clan laments, drinking songs, and work rhythms. Musical notation is simple enough for tavern performers.

items.name: A Survey of River Tolls
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A bureaucratic compilation of bridges, ferries, toll rates, exemptions, and charter rights along three major rivers. Official seals authenticate many copied decrees.

items.name: The Physician's Gray Manual
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A sober medical handbook on wounds, fractures, fevers, childbirth, diet, and convalescence. Its author repeatedly warns against heroic treatments and unnecessary bloodletting.

items.name: The Lantern Guild Almanac
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An annual guild publication listing festivals, market days, moon phases, road conditions, shipping notices, and tables for common measures and exchange rates.

items.name: Chronicle of the White Stag
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A courtly romance following generations of knights bound by a mysterious white stag. The manuscript is popular, finely copied, and decorated with vine-work initials.

items.name: The Steward's Household Book
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A comprehensive guide to provisioning, servant ranks, wages, inventories, feast planning, linen care, and the orderly running of a wealthy estate.

items.name: The Amber Apiary
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A beekeeper's treatise covering hive design, swarming, winter feeding, wax rendering, honey grading, and the medicinal use of propolis.

items.name: The Sea-Wolf Captains
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A dramatic history of notorious privateers, their ships, tactics, betrayals, and final fates. Several captains are depicted with questionable admiration.

items.name: The Weaver's Pattern Book
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A broad folio filled with colored textile patterns, border designs, loom settings, and notes on regional dyes. Loose scraps of thread remain tucked between pages.

items.name: The Book of Festival Tables
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A ceremonial household guide listing appropriate foods, colors, decorations, songs, and seating arrangements for holidays throughout the year.

items.name: Journeys Beyond the Salt Gate
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A travel narrative describing distant bazaars, caravanserais, temples, mountain passes, and strange local laws. The author has a keen eye for prices and practical hazards.

items.name: The Sable Company's Articles
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A copied mercenary charter covering pay, shares, discipline, ransoms, battlefield salvage, and obligations to wounded comrades. Corrections reflect years of hard experience.

items.name: The Cartwright's Wheel
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A craftsman's manual on hubs, spokes, rims, axles, suspension, wagon balance, and road repair. Smudged diagrams show measurements for several common vehicle sizes.

items.name: The Honeyed Tongue
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A rhetoric primer teaching persuasion, public speaking, negotiation, flattery, and the graceful refusal of unreasonable demands.

items.name: The Book of Eastern Spices
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An illustrated merchant's guide describing the appearance, origin, storage, adulteration, and culinary use of rare spices. Sample packets once attached to several pages are now empty.

items.name: The Abbey Fishponds
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A monastic handbook on breeding carp, managing ponds, controlling weeds, feeding stocks, and calculating sustainable harvests for fast days.

items.name: The King's Roads
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An official road survey naming milestones, bridges, inns, patrol posts, and seasonal hazards. The maps are unusually accurate for a privately owned copy.

items.name: The Crimson Midwife
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A respected manual on pregnancy, childbirth, infant care, and women's health. Practical experience is recorded plainly, with many warnings against superstition.

items.name: The Lore of Old Wells
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A folklore collection concerning sacred springs, poisoned wells, drowned bells, village taboos, and spirits said to dwell beneath still water.

items.name: The Goldsmith's Small Secrets
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A guarded workshop text describing alloying, soldering, filigree, repoussé work, polishing, weighing, and methods for detecting false coin and plated metal.

items.name: The Winter Court Masques
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A folio of scripts, costume notes, dances, stage devices, and songs performed at a famous royal winter court. The illustrations are bright and theatrical.

items.name: A Concordance of Heraldic Beasts
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A reference matching heraldic animals to virtues, families, regions, and traditional color combinations. Hundreds of tiny painted shields fill the margins.

items.name: The Shepherd's Moon
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A rural guide to lambing, pasture rotation, fleece grading, sheep diseases, predators, and weather signs observed by hill shepherds.

items.name: The Ivory Tower Disputations
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A collection of formal academic debates on logic, natural philosophy, theology, and law. Dense marginal commentary records later scholars' objections.

items.name: The Book of Painted Doors
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An architectural survey of famous carved and painted doors from temples, guildhalls, palaces, and tombs. Each plate is rendered in painstaking detail.

items.name: The Quiet Graveyard
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A cemetery keeper's manual on plot records, funerary customs, monument care, grave drainage, and respectful handling of unclaimed remains.

items.name: The Siege of Dun Avar
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An eyewitness military account of a famous siege, including diagrams of walls, engines, camps, supply lines, and daily troop losses.

items.name: The Perfumer's Garden
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A delicate handbook on fragrant flowers, oils, resins, distillation, blending, storage, and the social meanings attached to particular scents.

items.name: The Blacksmith's Temper
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A workshop treatise on forge heat, charcoal, quenching media, hammer technique, tool maintenance, and the treatment of common iron flaws.

items.name: Pilgrim Roads of the West
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A devotional travel guide listing shrines, relics, hospices, dangerous crossings, customary offerings, and prayers used at each stage of a western pilgrimage.

items.name: The Book of Minor Poisons
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A cautious apothecary's reference describing household toxins, spoiled foods, venomous creatures, symptoms, and emergency treatments. Preparation details are intentionally incomplete.

items.name: The Sapphire Chess Problems
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A luxury puzzle book containing one hundred composed chess positions, each followed by elegant analysis and commentary on strategy.

items.name: The Noble Art of Brewing
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A brewer's manual on malt, yeast, water, herbs, cask care, fermentation, and the judging of ales. Several recipes bear guild approval marks.

items.name: The City Beneath Bells
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A history and street-by-street description of an ancient cathedral city famed for its towers and bell foundries. Foldout views depict the skyline from four directions.

items.name: The Forester's Boundary Book
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A practical guide to woodland law, boundary marks, coppicing, charcoal burning, poaching signs, and sustainable timber cutting.

items.name: A Merchant's Book of Measures
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A comparative reference for weights, volumes, coinage, cloth lengths, and grain measures used across many realms. Conversion tables are heavily thumbed.

items.name: The Rose and the Raven
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A tragic courtly play about forbidden love, dynastic duty, and political murder. The copy includes performance notes from a well-known acting company.

items.name: The Monastery Vineyard
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A vintner's handbook covering pruning, grafting, soil, harvest timing, pressing, fermentation, cask selection, and cellar management.

items.name: The House of Seven Keys
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A popular mystery tale involving a locked manor, a vanished inheritance, and seven keys that each open the wrong door.

items.name: The Emerald Physician
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A richly illustrated medical herbal organized by leaf shape, flower color, habitat, and traditional use. Many plant images are heightened with green pigment.

items.name: The Royal Menagerie
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A court record describing exotic animals gifted to the crown, including their origins, diets, handlers, illnesses, and occasional escapes.

items.name: The Clerk's Perfect Hand
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A calligraphy and document-copying manual with alphabets, abbreviations, spacing guides, ink recipes, and exercises for formal legal scripts.

items.name: The Black Orchard
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A grim collection of rural tales about cursed trees, bitter harvests, family feuds, and bargains made during famine years.

items.name: The Captain's Tidebook
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A mariner's notebook of tides, shoals, moon phases, harbor approaches, and coastal landmarks, copied from generations of shipmasters.

items.name: The Architect of Gardens
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A noble landscape manual on terraces, fountains, hedges, orchards, sightlines, pavilions, and symbolic planting schemes.

items.name: The Bronze Bell Foundry
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A technical history and practical guide to bell casting, tuning, inscriptions, molds, alloy ratios, and tower installation.

items.name: The Linen Mistress
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A household reference on spinning, bleaching, starching, mending, storing, and counting linens for a large estate.

items.name: The Thousand-Mile Caravan
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A trader's narrative of a year-long caravan journey, emphasizing bargaining customs, water discipline, guards, pack animals, and desert storms.

items.name: The Court of Foxes
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A satirical beast fable in which foxes, wolves, stags, and hares mirror the scandals of an unnamed royal court.

items.name: The Book of Civic Fountains
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An engineering and civic-planning treatise on wells, cisterns, aqueducts, drainage, public fountains, and the laws governing shared water.

items.name: The Astronomer's Red Tables
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A set of calculation tables for tracking planets, eclipses, conjunctions, and calendar drift. Red ruling lines make the dense figures easier to follow.

items.name: The Baker's Dawn
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A practical baker's book of breads, rolls, pastries, ovens, starters, flour grades, and methods for feeding large households efficiently.

items.name: The Wolf Banner Campaigns
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A military history of three campaigns fought under the Wolf Banner, with maps, orders of battle, supply notes, and candid assessments of commanders.

items.name: The Book of Quiet Prayers
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A small, beautifully bound prayer book meant for private devotion. Its worn silk marker rests at a prayer for travelers far from home.

items.name: The Porcelain Roads
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A merchant geography tracing the long trade routes by which porcelain, silk, tea, and lacquer reach western markets.

items.name: The Tallow Chandler's Guide
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A trade manual on rendering fats, grading wax, making candles, preparing wicks, controlling smoke, and estimating burn time.

items.name: The Orchard of Kings
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An allegorical poem in which fruit trees represent royal virtues, failures, heirs, and the changing fortunes of dynasties.

items.name: The Harbor Master's Book
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A working reference on berths, pilots, quarantine, cargo inspection, mooring fees, tides, fire rules, and ship identification.

items.name: The Silver Thread
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A romance about a seamstress who uncovers a conspiracy through coded embroidery commissioned by rival noble houses.

items.name: The Bookbinder's Bench
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An artisan manual on sewing gatherings, preparing boards, tooling leather, making clasps, repairing spines, and protecting books from damp and insects.

items.name: The House Physician's Cases
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A private physician's anonymized casebook describing illnesses among wealthy households, treatments attempted, and long-term outcomes.

items.name: The Gray Friar's Sermons
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A collection of plainspoken sermons on greed, hospitality, violence, debt, and the duties owed to strangers.

items.name: The Festival of Masks
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An illustrated account of masked festivals across several regions, detailing costumes, dances, taboos, processions, and the meanings of traditional disguises.

items.name: The Iron Coast Pilot
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A rugged nautical guide to cliffs, reefs, storms, anchorages, wreck sites, and lighthouse signals along a notoriously dangerous coast.

items.name: The Book of Noble Funerals
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A ceremonial manual on mourning periods, funeral processions, heraldic display, grave goods, memorial feasts, and precedence among grieving families.

items.name: The Common Law of Inns
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A legal guide for innkeepers and travelers covering theft, damaged property, stabling, debts, brawls, guest privacy, and local licensing.

items.name: The Song of Ardent Vale
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A celebrated heroic epic about a valley kingdom resisting invasion through courage, sacrifice, and a final winter campaign.

items.name: The Painted Mapmaker
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A cartographic manual on surveying, scale, pigments, symbols, coastlines, road notation, and decorative borders.

items.name: The Distiller's Copper Book
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A technical volume on stills, fermentation, cuts, flavoring, storage, and excise customs. Several recipes are marked as guild secrets.

items.name: The Red Falcon Tournament
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An illustrated record of a famous tournament, listing competitors, coats of arms, bouts, injuries, prizes, and court gossip.

items.name: The Book of Village Charters
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A clerk's compilation of model charters covering mills, grazing rights, commons, markets, local courts, and village obligations to a lord.

items.name: The Emerald Sea Poems
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A refined poetry collection inspired by storms, sailors, sea birds, distant islands, and the grief of those waiting ashore.

items.name: The Palace Kitchens
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A grand culinary and household volume recording menus, staffing, storerooms, feast logistics, and favored dishes from a royal palace.

items.name: The Stonecutter's Flowers
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: An artisan pattern book of carved leaves, vines, blossoms, capitals, borders, and memorial motifs used in fine stonework.

items.name: The Book of Winter Games
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A social guide to indoor games, riddles, dice diversions, storytelling contests, and forfeits suitable for long winter evenings.

items.name: The Queen's Aviary
items.creator: Leo
items.desc: A luxurious record of songbirds, doves, parrots, and rare fowl kept in a royal aviary, with painted plates and notes from keepers.
